first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Star-filled night sky
entities.identification: The blue-cyan night sky in the upper part of the image, filled with stars, with a broad pinkish-white to pinkish-purple vertical band of light in the center.

entities.name: Lake surface
entities.identification: The blue water surface from the lower left to the lower center of the image, in the low area enclosed by the ridge, with reflections of stars and the pinkish-purple band of light.

entities.name: Ridge encircling the lake
entities.identification: The dark, undulating mountains surrounding the lake surface, including the ridgeline on the opposite shore and the steep wall descending toward the lakeshore on the right.

entities.name: Foreground rocky slope
entities.identification: The rough, dark-brown to gray-brown steep slope close to the camera on the right and lower right of the image.

entities.name: Evergreen thicket
entities.identification: The groups of dark thickets distributed along the foreground slope edge and hilltop, with crowns mostly forming pointed, narrow outlines.

entities.name: Foreground dead tree and dead branches
entities.identification: A short section of a dark, bent branch extending into the image from the lower-left edge, with the lake surface as its background.
